Location: Mapleview Mall, Unit BB12.  900 Maple Avenue, Burlington, ON L7S 2J8

 You have a sharp eye for detail and strong organizational skills, ensuring every piece of inventory is accounted for, easy to find, and accurately processed.
 You take ownership of store stock space and visual standards, proactive in maintaining inventory flow and elevating product presentation on the floor.
 You bring a team-first mindset and a willingness to roll up your sleeves, supporting store needs wherever you're needed most.
 You treat safety, efficiency, and organization as top priorities, creating a positive and smooth-running environment for both team members and clients.

 Keep it organized: You maintain an efficient, clean, and organized Stockroom — from merchandise and fixtures to marketing and visual props.
 Support visual excellence: You have a keen eye for detail and flag merchandising opportunities to leadership, collaborating on solutions to improve presentation and shopability.

 Prioritize safety: You follow all Asset Protection protocols and store policies, maintaining a safe and secure environment for both team and customers.
Qualifications: Previous experience in customer service or retail is considered an asset, but above all else, you’re great with people and are passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences.
 You love being part of a team and are a great collaborator.
 Ability to stay flexible, take initiative, and handle multiple tasks efficiently and with high attention to detail.
 An affinity for our product line and a belief in the Knix mission!
Eligibility Requirements: Must have the necessary work authorization to be legally employed in Canada and be 18 years of age or older.
 Ability to lift and handle packages weighing up to 25lbs.
 Ability to move efficiently through the store for long periods of time and as needed for an entire shift.
 Available to work a flexible schedule to meet the needs of the business, including holiday, evening, and weekend shifts.
Hourly Salary: $19.70 CAD per hour
Contract End Date: January 15, 2027

Hire Resolve is assisting petrochemical organizations in hiring experienced petrochemical professionals to support refinery, chemical, and downstream manufacturing operations across Canada. This is a multi-role opportunity spanning several functions within the sector, including plant operations, process and project engineering, reliability and maintenance, HSE and process safety, quality and laboratory functions, supply chain, and commercial/technical services. These roles are designed for mid- to senior-level professionals and offer a clear progression pathway toward senior leadership roles such as Operations/Production Manager, Engineering Manager, Reliability Lead, HSE/Process Safety Manager, and broader site leadership opportunities.
 Key Responsibilities
 Lead safe, efficient plant operations across continuous and batch processes, utilities, and supporting units 
 Drive process optimization, debottlenecking, yield improvement, energy efficiency, and cost reduction initiatives 
 Support or lead capital projects from scope definition through execution, commissioning, and handover 
 Maintain robust technical documentation and change control (P&IDs, SOPs, operating envelopes, MOC) 
 Strengthen asset reliability through preventive/predictive maintenance strategies, RCA, shutdown/turnaround planning, and integrity programs 
 Ensure compliance with applicable provincial OHS requirements and site HSE management systems, including process safety controls where applicable 
 Lead and participate in risk assessments (PHA/HAZOP/LOPA), incident investigations, and corrective action closeout 
 Manage contractors and safe systems of work (Permit to Work, isolations/LOTO, method statements and risk assessments) 
 Monitor and improve KPIs for safety, production, quality, reliability, and budget performance 
 Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, Laboratory, Supply Chain, and external vendors to deliver site objectives 
 Support internal and external audits and inspections; maintain continuous improvement initiatives 
 Coach and develop teams through training, competency development, and leadership support
 Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/Instrumentation Engineering, Chemistry, or a related discipline (a P.Eng. designation or eligibility is an advantage for certain engineering roles) 
 Typically 7–15+ years of experience in petrochemicals, refining, specialty chemicals, polymers, industrial gases, or comparable process manufacturing environments 
 Demonstrated experience in one or more functional tracks: operations leadership, process engineering, reliability/maintenance, rotating equipment, HSE/process safety, projects, quality/laboratory, or commercial/technical support 
 Working knowledge of safety and regulatory expectations in Canada (provincial OHS frameworks, contractor safety, hazardous energy control/LOTO, and process safety practices where applicable) 
 Familiarity with common plant systems and tools such as CMMS/EAM (e.g., SAP/Maximo), process historians (e.g., PI System), and standard engineering documentation practices 
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive delivery 
 Willingness to work onsite in an industrial environment; some roles may involve shift coverage, on-call rotation, or travel depending on site needs
 Extended Healthcare Plan (Medical, Disability, Dental & Vision)
 RPP - Group RRSP
 Group Life - AD&D - Critical Illness Insurance
 Paid Time Off Benefits
 Training & Development

Présentation de l'entreprise 
 Nous fabriquons et fournissons des médicaments et des vaccins fiables et de haute qualité afin de répondre aux besoins des patients et de soutenir notre performance.
 Notre réseau mondial de production joue un rôle essentiel dans la livraison de produits de santé aux patients partout dans le monde. Grâce à nos technologies de fabrication avancées, à nos solutions numériques et à nos pratiques d'amélioration continue, nous assurons l'excellence opérationnelle, la qualité des produits et la sécurité de nos employés.
 Nous recherchons des leaders inspirants qui souhaitent contribuer à l'innovation, à la performance des procédés et au développement des équipes techniques dans un environnement hautement réglementé et en constante évolution.
 Résumé du poste 
 Le Chef Technologie et Procédé est responsable de la direction stratégique et opérationnelle d'une équipe d'experts techniques soutenant les activités de fabrication de vaccins et d'adjuvants. Il assure la gouvernance technique des procédés, équipements et systèmes sous sa responsabilité tout en veillant à maintenir des opérations sécuritaires, robustes et conformes aux exigences réglementaires.
 À titre de leader, il collabore étroitement avec les équipes de Production, Qualité, Ingénierie, Affaires réglementaires et MSAT Global afin d'orienter les décisions techniques, anticiper les risques et soutenir la performance du site. Il joue un rôle essentiel dans l'amélioration continue des procédés, la gestion du cycle de vie des technologies et le développement des compétences de son équipe.
 Responsabilités 
 Cette fonction vous offrira l'occasion de diriger des activités clés afin de faire progresser votre carrière. Dans le cadre de ce rôle, vous serez notamment appelé(e) à :
 Établir et déployer les orientations stratégiques et opérationnelles de l'équipe en cohérence avec les priorités du site.
 Diriger, mobiliser, développer et évaluer une équipe de professionnels techniques, tout en favorisant leur développement et la planification de la relève.
 Maintenir une gouvernance technique rigoureuse des procédés, équipements, systèmes et technologies sous sa responsabilité.
 Assurer le suivi du cycle de vie des procédés, incluant les stratégies de contrôle, la validation et la vérification continue des procédés.
 Collaborer avec les fonctions partenaires afin d'aligner les priorités, anticiper les risques et faciliter une prise de décision efficace.
 Fournir une expertise technique lors des déviations de production, enquêtes, analyses de causes fondamentales et activités CAPA.
 Diriger les évaluations de risques reliées aux changements de procédés, d'équipements, de systèmes ou de matières.
 Piloter les initiatives d'amélioration continue visant à accroître la robustesse des procédés, la sécurité, la qualité et la performance opérationnelle.
 Utiliser les données et les outils numériques pour soutenir la prise de décision et l'optimisation des procédés.
 Assurer la conformité des activités aux exigences réglementaires, aux BPF et aux standards corporatifs.
 Développer des relations de collaboration fortes avec les intervenants locaux et globaux afin de soutenir les objectifs du site.
 Favoriser un environnement de travail fondé sur la confiance, la responsabilisation, la proactivité et l'innovation.
 Pourquoi vous? 
 Ce poste est offert sur notre site de Sainte-Foy dans un environnement manufacturier hautement réglementé où les activités techniques contribuent directement à la production de vaccins et de produits biologiques complexes.
 Vous aurez l'occasion d'exercer un rôle stratégique ayant un impact important sur la performance des procédés, la conformité réglementaire, le développement des équipes ainsi que la compétitivité du site. Vous intégrerez une organisation qui valorise l'innovation, la collaboration, le développement professionnel et l'amélioration continue.
 Compétences requises 
 Nous recherchons des professionnels possédant les compétences et qualifications suivantes :
 Diplôme universitaire en sciences, en ingénierie ou dans une discipline technique connexe.
 Expérience significative au sein de l'industrie pharmaceutique, biopharmaceutique ou de la fabrication de vaccins.
 Expérience démontrée en gestion de personnel et en développement d'équipes techniques.
 Expérience dans un environnement matriciel et multidisciplinaire.
 Expérience en gestion des risques et en gestion de projets.
 Solide connaissance des Bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF) et des exigences réglementaires applicables.
 Excellentes compétences en communication, en influence et en gestion des parties prenantes.
 Capacité démontrée à analyser des situations complexes et à prendre des décisions fondées sur des données scientifiques.
 Excellentes aptitudes en leadership, gestion de la performance et mobilisation d'équipe.
 Maîtrise avancée de l'anglais et capacité à évoluer dans un environnement bilingue.
 Qualifications souhaitées 
 Les qualifications suivantes constitueraient un atout :
 Expérience avec les vaccins, les adjuvants, les produits biologiques ou d'autres procédés stériles complexes.
 Expertise dans des domaines tels que la validation, le contrôle de la contamination, le nettoyage ou l'inspection visuelle.
 Expérience en transfert technologique, validation de procédés ou gestion du cycle de vie technique.
 Expérience dans la direction d'initiatives majeures d'amélioration continue.
 Capacité à synthétiser des informations provenant de plusieurs fonctions et à les traduire en orientations stratégiques claires.
 Connaissance des outils statistiques, analytiques et numériques utilisés pour la surveillance et l'optimisation des procédés.
 Ce que nous offrons 
 Vous aurez l'occasion d'évoluer au sein d'une organisation où la science, l'innovation, la qualité et la sécurité sont au cœur des activités. Vous contribuerez directement à l'évolution des technologies et des procédés de fabrication tout en développant votre leadership dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif.
 Nous favorisons l'apprentissage continu, l'inclusion, le développement professionnel et le travail d'équipe afin de permettre à chacun de réaliser son plein potentiel et de contribuer à l'amélioration de la santé des patients.
 Comment postuler 
 Nous aimerions faire votre connaissance. Veuillez soumettre votre curriculum vitæ accompagné d'un court texte décrivant une situation où vous avez dirigé une amélioration technique, opérationnelle ou organisationnelle ayant eu un impact mesurable sur la qualité, la performance ou la conformité d'un procédé ou d'une équipe.
 Postulez dès maintenant pour contribuer à l'innovation technologique, à l'excellence opérationnelle et au succès de nos équipes.
 Compétences 
CMC Strategy, Data-Driven Decision Making, Data Integrity, Debate Moderation, Digital Fluency, GxP Regulations, Lean Management, Problem Solving, Process Optimization, Project Leadership, Risk Awareness, Scientific Writing, Technology Transfer  
 Pourquoi GSK?
Allier science, technologie et talent pour vaincre ensemble la maladie. 
 GSK est une entreprise biopharmaceutique mondiale dont la mission est de réunir la science, la technologie et le talent pour prendre ensemble de l'avance sur les maladies. Nous visons à avoir un impact positif sur la santé de 2,5 milliards de personnes d'ici la fin de la décennie, en tant qu'entreprise prospère et en croissance où les gens peuvent s'épanouir. Nous prenons de l'avance sur les maladies en les prévenant et en les traitant grâce à l'innovation dans les médicaments spécialisés et les vaccins. Nous nous concentrons sur quatre domaines thérapeutiques : les maladies respiratoires, l'immunologie et l'inflammation; l'oncologie; le VIH; les maladies infectieuses – pour avoir un impact à grande échelle sur la santé.
 Les gens et les patients partout dans le monde comptent sur les médicaments et les vaccins que nous produisons; c'est pourquoi nous nous engageons à créer un environnement où nos employés peuvent s'épanouir et se concentrer sur ce qui compte le plus. Notre culture, qui repose sur l'ambition pour les patients, la responsabilité de la portée et le fait de faire ce qui est juste, constitue la base de la manière dont nous tenons nos engagements ensemble pour les patients, les actionnaires et nos employés.
 GSK est un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances. Cela garantit que tous les candidats qualifiés recevront une considération égale pour l'emploi sans distinction de race, de couleur, de religion, de sexe (y compris la grossesse, l'identité de genre et l'orientation sexuelle), de statut parental, d'origine nationale, d'âge, de handicap, d'informations génétiques (y compris les antécédents médicaux familiaux), de service militaire ou de toute autre base interdite par la loi fédérale, étatique ou locale. GSK s'engage à accueillir les personnes handicapées. Si vous avez besoin d'un aménagement à n'importe quelle étape du processus de candidature ou si vous souhaitez plus d'informations sur nos politiques d'aménagement, veuillez nous contacter à canada-recruitment@gsk.com . Veuillez ne pas envoyer de CV à cette adresse e-mail et postuler plutôt via le processus de candidature en ligne de cette annonce.
 Avis important destiné aux services/agences de placement 
 GSK n’accepte pas les propositions des services/agences de placement en vue de pourvoir les postes affichés dans le présent site. Ces services/agences doivent s’adresser au service d’approvisionnement/des ressources humaines de GSK pour obtenir une autorisation écrite avant de lui proposer des candidats. Cette autorisation est une condition préalable à toute entente (orale ou écrite) entre le service/l’agence de placement et GSK. Sans cette autorisation écrite, toute mesure de la part du service/de l’agence de placement doit être considérée comme avoir été appliquée sans le consentement ni l’entente contractuelle de GSK. Par conséquent, GSK ne peut pas être tenue responsable des honoraires attribuables à de telles mesures ni à quelque recommandation que ce soit de la part du service/de l’agence de placement en ce qui concerne sa proposition de candidature en vue de pouvoir un poste annoncé dans le présent site.

This AVP role also leads cross-functional planning and integration of strategic and operational programs, including True North program management support, enterprise promotional calendar management and project support for emerging initiatives.  What you will do 
 Enterprise print and distribution strategy 
 Develop a multi-year print and distribution strategy aligned with customer needs, promotional priorities and the price-value agenda.
 Lead the effective planning and delivery of flyer and print requirements, balancing customer impact, operational effectiveness, cost and business priorities.
 Translate banner priorities into production and distribution plans that balance reach, commercial impact, cost and feasibility.

 Simplify programmes and modernise capabilities, processes, tools and vendor partnerships to improve enterprise leverage.
 Flyer and promotional integration 
 Align print and distribution plans with flyer strategy, promotional calendars, major retail events and banner priorities.
 Partner across functions as promotional guardrails, resource allocation and annual promotional plans are developed.
 Define accountabilities and handoffs across promotional strategy, flyer development, creative, production and distribution.
 Partner with Digital, Loyalty and Analytics to coordinate print, digital and targeted communications around a consistent customer value proposition.
 Partner with Pricing & Promotion and Flyer & Customer Engagement on annual promotional plans, guardrails and resource allocation, ensuring communication requirements are operationally achievable.
 Establish cross-functional governance and operating rhythms with Marketing, Merchandising, Customer Strategy, Supply Chain, Store Operations and Finance to align priorities, timelines and accountabilities and resolve competing demands.
 Production and operational excellence 
 Lead print and distribution operations from demand planning and programme set-up through quality assurance and delivery.
 Set service standards, controls, escalation processes and measures to ensure accurate, timely delivery within quality and cost requirements.
 Lead contingency planning and resolve supply, capacity, production and distribution risks to critical promotional events.
 Strengthen planning, production visibility and partner coordination; drive process improvement, automation and innovation.
 Supports the digital evolution of print programs based on customer insights and analytics.
 Use financial insights and operational results to track performance, prioritize improvements and adapt execution plans as promotional priorities and business requirements change.
 Strategic sourcing and partner management 
 Set the sourcing and partner strategy for print, distribution and related services with Procurement.
 Govern strategic suppliers through service-level agreements, capacity planning, risk management and continuous improvement.
 Support major negotiations to secure value, flexibility, quality and service.
 Build transparent relationships with printers, distributors, logistics partners and specialist providers.
 Monitor emerging print, distribution, sustainability and measurement capabilities.
 Maintain supplier contingency and business-continuity plans.
 Gift-card programme leadership 
 Lead enterprise gift-card programme priorities and operational performance, aligning banner, partner and operational needs.
 Partner with Digital, Technology, Finance, Legal and other stakeholders on programme changes and capabilities.
 Strengthen gift-card operational controls, processes and execution, partnering across banners and functions to improve the customer experience and programme effectiveness.
 Team leadership and capability development 
 Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team with clear objectives, accountability and development plans.
 Foster an inclusive, collaborative environment that connects team priorities to enterprise and customer outcomes.
 Build succession depth and cross-functional capability, leading teams through change and the adoption of new processes, technology and ways of working.
 Lead cross-functional planning and integration of strategic and operational programs, including True North program management support, enterprise promotional calendar management and project support for pricing & promotions initiatives.
 What you bring 
 At least 8-10 years of progressive leadership experience in print production, retail marketing, promotional or commercial operations, distribution, procurement, gift cards or a related field.
 Demonstrated experience leading complex, enterprise-scale operational programs with multiple stakeholders and dependencies.
 Proven ability translating commercial strategy into operational execution.
 Strong experience leading teams and developing leaders in a complex, matrixed organization.
 Strong commercial and financial acumen, including substantial budgets, investment trade-offs and cost improvement.
 Experience managing strategic suppliers and supporting complex sourcing and negotiations.
 Ability to use customer, performance, coverage and financial data to guide decisions.
 Experience in a multi-banner, multi-brand, franchise, dealer or similarly complex retail environment is an asset.
 Understanding of omnichannel marketing across print, digital, loyalty and personalised communications.
 Ability to influence senior leaders and align partners in a matrixed organisation, with executive-level communication, judgement and problem-solving skills.
 Strong people leadership, including developing leaders, building capability and fostering accountability.
 An enterprise mindset and demonstrated change leadership, with the ability to simplify complex environments, standardise practices across banners and guide teams through transformation.
 A degree in business, marketing, operations, supply chain, finance or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Aviso: 
 At Aviso, we are dedicated to improving the financial well-being of Canadians. As a leading wealth management organization, we are committed to leadership, innovation, partnership, responsibility, and community. Working with talented and energetic professionals who exemplify our values every day, you will quickly notice that our people and dynamic ‘oneaviso’ culture sets us apart. If you are looking for interesting and challenging work, at a company committed to its people, find out more about what Aviso has to offer at www.aviso.ca .
 The Opportunity: 
 We’re looking to fill an opening for a Mutual Funds, Senior Trader to join our Trading team.
 Reporting to the Manager, Mutual Funds, the Mutual Funds, Senior Trader is responsible for insuring support and problem resolutions with all activities with Mutual Funds and plays a decisive role in placing daily Mutual Fund Trades for Portfolio Managers, Investment Advisors, and staff. Supporting the Manager, Mutual Funds, the incumbent will gain a broad range of knowledge and is responsible in maintaining a high degree of professionalism while ensuring high levels of client service satisfaction.
 As one aviso: 
 We Care – You do the right thing for clients, partners and colleagues. You build trusted relationships, champion service excellence, and contribute to a culture where people feel valued and supported
 We Dare –You challenge the status quo with bold ideas and fresh perspectives. You embrace change, seek opportunities to innovate and are comfortable exploring new ways of working
 We Share – You collaborate openly and build meaningful relationships. You seek out diverse perspectives, share your knowledge and work together to help colleagues, clients and partners succeed
 We Deliver – You take ownership of your work, honour your commitments and focus on delivering meaningful results. You hold yourself accountable and continuously look for ways to improve
 What your day looks like: 
 Supports and performs daily executions of Mutual Fund trade orders Buys, Sells, and Switches on Dataphile
 Executes trades and cancellation orders via FundSERV if mandatory
 Supporting correspondent for Portfolio Managers, co-workers and various other Departments within the Firm to resolve escalated complaints, disputes or issues whether Client or system oriented and escalating when required
 Supports ongoing communications with Mutual Fund Companies, Regulators and Network providers to discuss and be kept abreast of any developments or changes in the industry
 Daily review of all executed and rejected trades
 Learning to calculate dilution loses or gains
 Monthly upkeep of duplicate Mutual Fund account numbers and dormant trades on the order book.
 Support PM’s and staff with the different types of Mutual Fund products, back office system along with procedures and regulations 
 Administers recurring Events for all PM’s ensuring accurate processing
 Frequently answers to calls or emails with PM’s or internally to resolve or address any issues in a Client’s account and escalate when appropriate
 Revises and makes modifications to the Mutual Funds Procedure Manual keeping it up-to-date at all times
 Ensures accurate Client demographics information with Fund Companies is maintained for proper tax reporting
 Support various Departments by being a liaison between them and the PM’s on issues which affect the day to day efficiencies of our businesses
 Identifies and recommends processing improvements in the Mutual Fund operations and administrative functions to enhance productivity and profitability
 Meets established service standards for problem resolution and customer service
 Analyze trends and recommend process or operational improvements with staff and PM’s
 Supports PM’s with understanding Dataphile, different entry types, modules and order book processing
 Resolve concerns with customer accounts. Forward complaints and errors to appropriate department in a timely fashion
 Escalates administrative issues found within Departments or staff which are discovered through interactions with PM’s and internal staff
 Supports projects and follow ups to our Credential partners, fund companies and outside institutions to provide additional client services
 Recommend improvements to service quality where applicable; actively seek areas for improvement within Broker Solutions and the service provided to Credential partners and investors
 Identify areas for process improvement, makes the recommendations and once approved, implements them
 Supports senior team members to perform regular monthly, quarterly and annual duties
 Requirements 
 Your experience and skills: 
 Post secondary education
 5 – 10 years of experience in the Investment Industry with a good understanding of Mutual Fund Investments
 Successful completion of the CSC & CPH or the IFIC
 Understanding of FundSERV N$M settlements; purchases, redemptions, switches, cash/reinvested and notional distributions, PAC/SWD’s transfer-ins and outs, rollovers, exchanges, commissions and trailer fees
 Understanding of various Mutual Fund Products; Hedge, Pooled, Investment Trusts, Flow-thru shares, Linked notes, GIC’s, HISA’s and open-end Mutual Funds
 Recognizes and understands the regulatory rules governing Mutual Funds established by IIROC and MFDA
 Outstanding versatility with the ability to conduct with professionalism, build rapport and exercise resourcefulness and understanding
 Proficient computer skills and good knowledge of FundSERV, myserv, Broadridge, MS word, Excel, and Outlook
 Independent and self-motivated and understands when to escalate issues
 Team-oriented with a positive attitude; thrive in fast-paced environments and multi-task oriented
 Maintains the quality and operational excellence with the highest level of service
 Capable to achieve required objectives within the Company and regulatory requirements
 Attends to details and pursues quality in accomplishing tasks
 Strong organizational and time management skills; Strong customer service orientation
 Fluent communication skills in both English and French are required, with the ability to collaborate effectively with others
 Benefits 
 Why Aviso Wealth? 
 At Aviso Wealth, you will find a dynamic and inclusive culture that rewards innovation and celebrates success. 
 Here are a few things that set us apart: 
 Competitive compensation package that rewards and recognizes individual contributions
 Excellent health, dental and insurance benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees
 Generous vacation time, fitness benefit, parental leave top-up options
 Matching contributions to our retirement program
 Commitment to the continuous improvement of our staff through learning & development and an education assistance program
 Regular social events to foster teamwork
 Your Information 
 By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use, and disclosure of your provided personal information for the purposes of assessing your qualifications and suitability for employment with Aviso. Your information will be handled in accordance with applicable Canadian privacy laws, including the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and relevant provincial legislation. Your data may be shared with authorized personnel involved in the recruitment process and retained only as long as necessary to fulfill these purposes or as required by law.
 Further information is available on the Privacy link on our Career Page – Privacy Policies 
 Equal Employment Opportunity 
 Aviso welcomes and encourages applications from all qualified individuals including persons with disabilities. If you require an accommodation, we will work with you to meet your needs in all stages of the hiring process.
 We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.
 No recruiters or agencies, please.
 Company Overview: 
 Aviso is a leading wealth management and investment services provider for the Canadian financial industry, with approximately $145 billion in total assets under administration and management, and over 1,000 employees. We’re building a comprehensive, technology-enabled, client-centric wealth services ecosystem. Our clients include our partners, advisors, and investors. We’re a trusted partner for nearly all credit unions across Canada, in addition to a wide range of portfolio managers, investment dealers, insurance and trust companies, and introducing brokers. Our partners depend on Aviso for specific solutions that give them a competitive edge in a rapidly evolving, highly competitive industry. Our investment dealer and mutual fund dealer and our insurance services support thousands of investment advisors. Our asset manager, NEI Investments, specializes in investing responsibly. Our online brokerage, Qtrade Direct Investing®, empowers self-directed investors, and our fully automated investing service, Qtrade Guided Portfolios®, serves investors who prefer a hands-off approach. Aviso Correspondent Partners provides custodial and carrying broker services to a wide range of firms. We have offices in Toronto, Vancouver, and Montreal. Aviso is backed by the collective strength of our owners: the credit union Centrals, Co-operators/CUMIS, and Desjardins. We’re proud to power businesses that empower investors .
 A career with Aviso means being part of a group of talented, energetic professionals who live their values every day, and belonging to an organization dedicated to your success and career development. If you’re looking for interesting and challenging work, at a company committed to its people, apply to join our team.
 Salary 
 This position is posted with an expected salary range of 75,000 - $95,000 CAD annually. Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate and the requirements of the position.

About Behavox: 
 Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world. 
 From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise. 
 Our approach is unique, and it’s validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are. 
 We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before. 
 This is a hybrid role with 1 day in the office. 
 About the Role: 
 The Senior HR Business Partner is an individual contributor responsible for partnering with US and Canada business leaders to execute people strategies that support organizational performance and growth. 
 The role applies strong business acumen and HR expertise to advise leaders on workforce planning, performance management, employee relations, and organizational effectiveness within the US and Canada client group, and covers this territory directly and in full. 
 Reporting to the Principal HR Business Partner, the Senior HR Business Partner partners with leaders to deliver people initiatives while ensuring alignment with global frameworks and applicable US and Canada employment requirements. 
 During the initial phase of the role, the Senior HR Business Partner works under close coaching from the Principal HR Business Partner while building full ownership of the client group; oversight reduces as competence across the remit is demonstrated. 
 The role supports workforce planning, organizational design, and post-merger workforce integration workstreams for its client group, executes assigned enterprise HR programs and projects, and independently manages moderate-to-complex employee relations matters, escalating matters of significant complexity, cross-jurisdictional exposure, or elevated organizational risk to the Principal HR Business Partner. 
 It uses workforce data and people metrics to inform recommendations for its client group, and may be asked to support the Principal HR Business Partner on workforce matters outside the US and Canada as the function's footprint grows. 
 What You'll Bring: 
 HR Business Partnering — Applies working knowledge of business priorities and workforce needs within the US and Canada client group to align people initiatives with business objectives and provide trusted advisory support to leaders and managers at all levels. 
 Workforce Planning and Organizational Support — Applies workforce planning methodologies and organizational design principles to support headcount planning, org changes, and business effectiveness within the client group, in line with the framework set by the Principal HR Business Partner. 
 Employment Law and Employee Relations (US & Canada) — Maintains working knowledge of US and Canadian employment legislation and regulatory frameworks, independently managing moderate-to-complex employee relations matters within those jurisdictions. Working knowledge of employment fundamentals in other jurisdictions (e.g., UK, EMEA, APAC) is desirable, as the role may be asked to support the wider HR Business Partner team outside its core territory. 
 Talent Management and Performance — Applies performance management, career development, and talent process knowledge to support capability development within the client group. 
 People Analytics — Uses workforce metrics, organizational data, and HRIS-derived reporting to evaluate trends and support evidence-based decisions within the client group. 
 What You'll Do: 
 HR Advisory — Provides sound, commercially informed HR guidance to leaders on moderate-to-complex workforce and talent challenges within the US and Canada client group, exercising judgment on approach and escalating matters that exceed this level's scope. 
 Employee Relations Case Management — Manages moderate-to-complex employee relations cases end-to-end within US and Canada employment frameworks, balancing legal compliance, business priorities, and employee experience. 
 People Program Delivery — Delivers and locally adapts HR programs (performance cycles, workforce planning inputs, career development processes) for the client group in line with enterprise standards. 
 Workforce Data Interpretation — Interprets workforce data and people metrics for the client group to identify trends and inform recommendations to leaders, including through periods of increased organizational scrutiny or governance rigor (e.g., audit readiness, compliance program maturation, or a prior employer's scale-up or pre-exit period). 
 Compensation Analysis — Applies compensation data and benchmarking to support pay recommendations, offer construction, and pay equity considerations for the client group, escalating matters requiring Principal-level or Total Rewards review. 
 What We Offer 
 The opportunity to work on a global, mission-critical AI platform alongside the best engineers and technologists across multiple geographies 
 A role with real ownership and impact, building complex systems at scale in an environment that values speed, experimentation, and technical excellence 
 A highly attractive benefits package, including competitive cash compensation, an equity award aligned with long-term value creation, and comprehensive health insurance for employees and their families 
 Modern, comfortable offices in Montreal/Toronto downtown, with an expectation of (hybrid) working from the office 1 day per week, reflecting our belief in strong in-person collaboration. 
 A generous time-off policy of 30 days annually, plus public holidays and sick leave, recognizing the importance of sustained high performance 
 About Our Process 
 We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment. 
 During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies. 
 The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible. 
 Please note that: 
 We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process. 
 Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

Infirmier(ère) clinicien(ne) – Urgence & Salle de choc au CS Chibougamau | Baie-James
 Services SFT est une agence de placement de premier plan spécialisée dans le déploiement de professionnels de la santé partout au Québec. Nous accompagnons les établissements du réseau public dans la couverture de leurs besoins en main-d'œuvre indépendante, tout en offrant à nos candidats des opportunités de carrière uniques, un encadrement rigoureux et des mandats d'envergure.
 Nous recherchons actuellement une Infirmière ou un Infirmier de haut niveau pour combler un mandat de longue durée dans un contexte clinique exigeant et isolé.
 Description du poste
 Intégrez l'équipe de pointe de la Direction des soins infirmiers (DSI) au Centre de santé de Chibougamau . Au sein du département de l' Urgence , vous agirez comme leader clinique. Compte tenu de l'éloignement régional et des équipes réduites, vous serez appelé(e) à assurer un leadership fort en salle de choc/réanimation et à prendre des décisions critiques rapidement.
 Détails du mandat : 
 Période du besoin : Du 11 novembre 2026 au 10 août 2027 (Mandat de 9 mois).
 Quarts de travail : Rotation Jour-Soir .
 Type d'horaire : Horaire atypique en formule 7/7 , avec des quarts de 8 heures et/ou 12 heures selon les besoins de l'installation.
 Temps de repas : 45 minutes pour les quarts de 8 heures | 1 heure pour les quarts de 12 heures.
 Garde (On-Call) : Non.
 Orientation : Une période d'orientation est requise et entièrement planifiée à votre arrivée.
 Vos responsabilités
 Assurer la prise en charge globale des patients aux urgences, de l'évaluation initiale à la stabilisation.
 Prendre le leadership des interventions critiques en salle de choc et en salle de réanimation.
 Effectuer le triage des patients de manière autonome et sécuritaire selon l'échelle CTAS.
 Collaborer activement avec les équipes médicales réduites et assurer les communications cliniques requises, parfois en anglais.
 Exigences:
 Ordre professionnel : Membre en règle et inscription valide au tableau de l' Ordre des infirmières et infirmiers du Québec (OIIQ) .
 Expérience à l'urgence : Minimum de 3 ans d'expérience consolidée à l'urgence (incluant obligatoirement la salle de réanimation). Note : Les candidatures dont l'expérience n'a pas été acquise dans des urgences comparables et à haut roulement pourront être refusées. 
 Expérience au triage : Minimum de 1 an et plus d'expérience active au triage avec la formation officielle CTAS complétée.
 Formations obligatoires : Cours d'arythmie complété avec succès.
 Outils d'accès : Posséder une clé DSQ (Dossier de santé Québec) active.
 Systèmes informatiques : Connaissance fonctionnelle des logiciels DCI-Cristal Net, MedUrge et SIL-P .
 Compétences linguistiques : Niveau intermédiaire/avancé en anglais (capacité à bien se débrouiller en contexte clinique).
 Atouts majeurs : Certifications ACLS (Soins avancés en réanimation cardiorespiratoire) et ATLS (Advanced Trauma Life Support).
 Avantages:
 Un accompagnement personnalisé de haut niveau par l'équipe des Normes SFT tout au long de ce mandat d'envergure.
 Une excellente stabilité d'emploi avec un contrat de 9 mois complets.
 Une rémunération globale très compétitive, à la hauteur de votre expertise en soins critiques.
 Le taux horaire de 80$/H et 50$/jour travaillé.
 Intéressé(e) ? 
 Envoyez votre CV à jour à :
 info.sft@sftechniques.com 
 Vous pouvez également nous contacter au (438) 946-6340 .
 Notre équipe se fera un plaisir de répondre à toutes vos questions.

 A candidate who is obsessed with process improvement, automation, and finding efficiencies in on-going operations

 À propos de Partner One
 Partner One est un groupe d’investissement en pleine croissance qui acquiert et exploite des entreprises de logiciels parmi les plus réputées de leur secteur.  Nous privilégions un modèle décentralisé qui permet à chaque unité d’affaires de fonctionner avec agilité, tout en bénéficiant du soutien d’une infrastructure mondiale de services partagés.
 Description du poste
 Nous sommes à la recherche d’un contrôleur ou d’une contrôleuse d’unité d’affaires pour superviser les activités financières et la performance d’une ou de plusieurs unités d’affaires du secteur des logiciels au sein du groupe Partner One.

 Exigences

 Excellente compréhension des indicateurs financiers propres aux entreprises SaaS et des principes de comptabilisation des revenus.
 Expérience démontrée en production de rapports financiers, en consolidation, en budgétisation et en analyse financière.
 Maîtrise de systèmes comptables tels que Sage Intacct ou NetSuite, ainsi que d’Excel et de la modélisation financière.
 Excellentes capacités d’analyse, de communication et d’organisation.
 Capacité à s’épanouir dans un environnement de travail à distance, international et en constante évolution.
 Expérience démontrée dans la création et le développement d’équipes ainsi que dans l’encadrement du personnel.
 Forte volonté d’améliorer continuellement les processus, d’automatiser les opérations et de trouver des moyens d’accroître l’efficacité des activités courantes.

Our Contract Management team plays a critical role in helping customers navigate renewal and commercial conversations thoughtfully, strategically, and with a high degree of trust. We are building a team that takes pride in delivering exceptional customer experiences while also protecting the long-term health of the business, and I am excited to be hiring a Manager of Contract Management (Renewals) to help scale and evolve this function.

In this role, you’ll lead and develop a team of Startup Contract Managers responsible for guiding customers through renewals, pricing conversations, negotiations, and long-term partnership planning. A key part of this role is helping the team navigate increasingly complex commercial conversations while building scalable processes, operational rigor, and repeatable frameworks that elevate both the customer experience and the effectiveness of the Contract Management organization.

You’ll partner closely with leaders across Customer Success, Sales, RevOps, Product, Legal, Finance, and Support to help shape how Ashby approaches renewals and long-term customer growth as we continue to scale upmarket.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Manager of Contract Management, you’ll lead a team of global Startup Contract Managers responsible for renewal strategy, customer retention, and commercial partnership management across Ashby’s customer base. You’ll act as a coach, operator, and strategic thought partner — helping the team grow their commercial acumen, negotiation capabilities, and customer judgment while also building scalable systems and processes that allow the organization to operate effectively at scale.

In this role, you will:

 - Lead and coach a team of 6 Startup Contract Managers (4 in America and 2 in EMEA) responsible for renewals, contract negotiations, and commercial partnership conversations. These individuals do high volume, about 400-450+ annual contract renewals.

 - Up-level team performance through thoughtful coaching, operational discipline, and skill development across negotiation strategy, forecasting, customer communication, and stakeholder management

 - Help build scalable renewal processes, systems, and operational workflows that improve efficiency while preserving a high-touch customer experience

 - Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, Support, and RevOps to align on customer strategy and commercial outcomes

 - Drive consistency in renewal execution, forecasting accuracy, CRM hygiene, and pricing governance across the team

 - Support the team in navigating complex negotiations involving procurement, legal, executive stakeholders, pricing transitions, and multi-product commercial conversations

 - Translate successful negotiation strategies and customer patterns into repeatable frameworks, playbooks, and enablement materials for the broader organization

 - Help shape the long-term vision and operational strategy for the Contract Management function as Ashby continues to scale


ROLE REQUIREMENTS


TEAM LEADERSHIP & COACHING

You have experience leading and developing high-performing customer-facing teams in a B2B SaaS environment. You know how to foster a culture centered around empathy, accountability, creativity, and transparency, while helping individuals grow through thoughtful coaching and continuous feedback.


COMMERCIAL ACUMEN & NEGOTIATION STRATEGY

You have deep experience managing or overseeing complex renewals, pricing conversations, and contract negotiations. You understand how to balance customer partnership with commercial integrity, and can coach teams through nuanced negotiation scenarios with confidence and sound judgment.


RENEWAL STRATEGY & FORECASTING

You understand how to proactively manage renewal risk, expansion opportunities, forecasting accuracy, and long-term account planning. You bring structure and discipline to renewal operations while remaining adaptable in dynamic customer situations.


OPERATIONAL MINDSET

You have experience building or improving scalable systems, workflows, and processes that allow teams to operate effectively at scale. You value operational excellence, data accuracy, and thoughtful process design.


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

You are comfortable partnering across Sales, Customer Success, Product, RevOps, Legal, Finance, and Support to align around customer needs, pricing strategy, and long-term business outcomes.


CUSTOMER & EXECUTIVE COMMUNICATION

You are an excellent communicator who can navigate challenging conversations with empathy, professionalism, and clarity. You know how to build trust with both customers and internal stakeholders while maintaining transparency throughout the renewal process.


PROBLEM-SOLVING ORIENTATION

You don’t rely solely on “what worked before.” You are thoughtful, adaptable, and solutions-oriented — able to navigate ambiguity and develop creative approaches to complex commercial challenges.


DATA-DRIVEN & STRATEGIC

You are comfortable using data, trends, customer insights, and operational metrics to drive decision-making and improve both team performance and customer outcomes.




YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

 - You communicate with clarity and empathy. You ask thoughtful questions, simplify complex concepts, and build trust through transparent communication.

 - You enjoy coaching. You see every negotiation, renewal, and customer interaction as an opportunity to help your team learn and grow.

 - You are highly operational. You value strong internal systems, accurate forecasting, clean data, and scalable process design.

 - You thrive in dynamic environments. You are energized by solving complex problems and adapting processes as the business evolves.

 - You balance customer advocacy with business integrity. You can empathize deeply with customer needs while confidently protecting Ashby’s long-term commercial interests.

 - You are a strategic problem solver. You know how to navigate ambiguity, identify creative solutions, and align multiple stakeholders toward a shared outcome.

 - You enjoy building. You are excited about helping shape the future of the Contract Management organization and scaling its impact across Ashby.


YOU MIGHT NOT BE A FIT IF:

 - You prefer highly rigid, unchanging processes and environments.

 - You are uncomfortable navigating pricing conversations, negotiations, or commercial ambiguity.

 - You prefer operating independently rather than through cross-functional collaboration and team development.

 - You are more interested in defining high-level strategy than owning execution alongside your team.

 - You avoid operational detail, forecasting rigor, or system/process improvement work.

 - You are uncomfortable balancing customer empathy with accountability and commercial discipline.

 - You prefer transactional customer interactions over long-term strategic partnership building.


OUR PHILOSOPHY

Here are a few key points (relevant to the go-to-market side) that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

 - We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to position and support in commercial conversations.

 - We believe deeply in pairing customer empathy with accountability and operational excellence.

 - We value thoughtful communication, principled decision-making, and strong ownership across every function.

 - We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people deliver significantly better outcomes than large teams with unclear ownership or low accountability.

 - We care deeply about helping customers succeed while also building a sustainable, scalable business.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication — we’ll get into these and other values throughout the interview process.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

At Ashby, our interview process is designed to help you show your best self while also giving you insight into how we operate as a team. The process typically includes:

 - Recruiter Screen - 30 minutes

 - Hiring Manager Interview - 45 minutes

 - Strategic Exercise - Take-home assignment

 - Final Round - 2 hours
   
   - Rather than a traditional panel interview with a large group, we structure our panel into a series of smaller conversations. This gives you the opportunity to meet with multiple team members in a more conversational setting focused on specific topics, instead of a formal Q&A. 


BENEFITS

 - You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.

 - 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby - do it when you feel financially comfortable.

 - Unlimited PTO with four weeks is recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

 - Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

 - Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

 - $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
   
   
   
   Ashby’s success hinges on hiring exceptional people and creating an environment where they can do their best work. We’re being intentional about building that environment from the ground up, and we hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

Who We Are   
 Rising Edge Group is an electrical contracting company founded in 2002, specialization in high-voltage electrical solutions that power critical infrastructure across North America. With operations in both Canada and the United States, we partner with clients across the electrical utilities, renewable energy, and industrial sectors to design, build, and maintain the critical infrastructure systems communities and industries rely on.   
 Driven by a clear vision to strengthen the stability, reliability, and advancement of energy infrastructure, we take pride in delivering work that matters. Guided by our STRIDE values - Safety, Teamwork, Responsibility, Integrity, Deliver, and Excellence - we foster a people focused on a culture of growth, mentorship and collaboration where safety always come first.  
 What You'll Do   
 Reporting to the Procurement Manager, the Purchasing Administrator supports day-to-day procurement activities across multiple projects for the purchasing team. This role plays a key part in ensuring materials and services are sourced cost-effectively, delivered on time, and accurately tracked throughout the project lifecycle. This may include filing, reconciling field credit card receipts/statements, travel invoice coding, and ordering tools, materials, and site services for projects at the best price and ensuring they are delivered/available as required.   
 Key Responsibilities 
 The responsibilities include, but may not be limited to:  
 Execute purchasing activities in accordance with company procurement policies and procedures
 Support Procurement, Project Managers, and internal teams with sourcing materials and services for active projects
 Create and process Purchase Orders (POs) and Change Orders in Viewpoint ensuring accuracy and compliance with company standards
 Review and maintain project Bills of Materials (BOMs), updating status from initial order through to PO closeout
 Monitor open POs, follow up with vendors, and expedite deliveries to meet project timelines
 Issue Requests for Quotations (RFQs) and Requests for Proposals (RFPs) as required
 Maintain and update the material database, ensuring accurate pricing and proper material coding for estimating purposes
 Support subcontractor prequalification processes in collaboration with Procurement and Safety teams
 Reconcile field credit card transactions and create POs to support monthly accounting processes
 Review and follow up on invoices to ensure accurate project costing and timely vendor payment
 Action outstanding items from open PO reports and monthly Accounts Payable (AP) action lists
 Maintain organized procurement documentation in project folders and internal systems
 Communicate regularly with field teams, project stakeholders, and vendors regarding order status and delivery timelines
 Perform general administrative duties and support special projects as assigned by the Procurement Manager
 Additional Information     
 As a condition of employment, candidates will be required to complete pre-employment screening including professional reference checks and a criminal record check.
 What We're Looking For   
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field, with 1+ years of purchasing experience or Diploma in a related field with 2+ years of purchasing experience
 SCMP designation or enrollment is considered an asset
 Experience procuring materials and equipment within the electrical utility or construction industry is an asset
 Knowledge of contract law within Canada; familiarity with contract law in California and North Carolina is an asset
 Strong computer skills in a Windows environment, including Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and SharePoint
 Experience with Viewpoint (Vista) Construction Software is an asset
 Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail
 Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams
 Well-developed negotiation, problem-solving, and conflict resolution abilities
 Benefits 
 Competitive compensation with weekly pay periods 
 Overtime opportunities (project dependent)  
 Generous paid time off  
 RRSP-DPSP employer matching, increasing with years of service 
 Comprehensive benefits package (medical, dental, vision, and disability)  
 Company-paid safety training  
 Annual PPE allowance provided for field-based employees (post-probation)  
 Out-of-town work includes either all-inclusive camp accommodations or LOA and individual accommodations (project dependent) 
 Travel time to and from site will be paid at base rate, and travel provided by employer (project dependent)  
 Ongoing training, development, and career advancement opportunities 
 Employee Assistance Program (confidential counselling support) 
 Employee Referral Bonus Program  
 Why Rising Edge Group?   
 Safety & Excellence:   Safety is at the heart of everything we do.  Every project is approached with diligence, strategic planning, and reliable execution practices to protect our teams and the clients we serve while delivering world-class high-voltage solutions. Our unwavering commitment to safety and quality drives excellence on every project, every day.   
 People-First Culture :  You’re more than a job title.  Every person contributes to powering essential energy infrastructure across North America. Our teams are built on collaboration, respect, and accountability. We support our employees through meaningful engagement initiatives, team events, and a culture that prioritizes wellbeing, inclusion, and genuine lasting connections.                                                                                              
 Career Growth & Impact :  Your role is a path to a long-term career.  We empower our employees with hands-on experience, exposure to diverse projects, and opportunities to advance across disciplines, locations, and career paths. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development, you’ll build lasting expertise while making a tangible impact in an environment where teamwork and integrity guide our work. 
 Reward & Recognition :  We believe skill, dedication, and excellence deserves recognition . Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a strong culture of appreciation ensure your achievements are celebrated, your growth is supported, and your work truly makes a difference.

About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.



Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.



Our vision



We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.



But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.



Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.



In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.



Our traction



Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com http://Owner.com website.



More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.



Our team



Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.



We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.



Where we work



Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!





Role Overview

Owner is the leading all-in-one platform for independent restaurants, and 2026 is the year we engineer a true product-led growth motion: restaurant owners should be able to go from discovering Owner all the way to running their whole business on it, opting into each next step because they trust it's worth it.

As we scale that motion, we're expanding our product engineering leadership to accelerate our ability to ship fast, delight restaurant owners, and build infrastructure that scales with us. As an Engineering Manager for Launch and Websites, you'll lead teams of fullstack engineers building the core product surfaces owners rely on every day - from the self-serve launch journey that takes them from Grader to POS, to the website design, builder, and generation systems that put their brand online. This role is equal parts product intuition and technical execution. You'll be trusted to make fast, high-quality decisions, ship impactful features, and grow a team that embodies engineering excellence.

We move with urgency, bias toward simplicity, and expect our leaders to be hands-on when needed. If you're energized by ownership, decisive execution, and solving real problems for small business owners, we'd love to hear from you.



Why we’re looking for you

Today, most restaurant owners lose an enormous amount of time and trust just getting live on Owner and getting a website that actually represents their brand, instead of running their business. Launch owns the self-serve journey that takes an owner from Grader all the way to POS - engineering the automation and trust signals that let owners opt into each next step without needing a person to walk them through it. Websites owns the design, builder, and AI-powered generation systems that put a restaurant's brand online, closing the customization gaps that drive churn and increasing the number of high-quality sites we launch.

These two teams sit at the center of Owner's product-led growth motion this year - systems directly in the critical path for how independent restaurants activate, launch, and show up online.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager who cares deeply about the craft and the team behind it - someone who's led full-stack engineers building customer-facing product end-to-end, and who's excited to build a strong, durable engineering culture across two of our most strategically important product areas.



Our Stack

 - Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript

 - Backend: Node.js, TypeScript

 - Databases: MongoDB, PostgreSQL

 - Infrastructure & Observability: Temporal, Datadog, AWS

 - TypeScript everywhere



What we’re looking for

 - ~3 years of experience in a software engineering management role leading fullstack product engineering teams, preferably in high-growth environments

 - A track record of leading high-performing, engaged full-stack engineering teams - not purely backend-platform or purely frontend teams

 - Strong product sense and an instinct for balancing speed, quality, and user impact

 - Experience with modern frontend frameworks (e.g. React) and backend systems (e.g. Node.js)

 - High degree of cross-functional collaboration - past colleagues in product, design, and business would speak highly of your teamwork

 - A plus: growth or PLG experience (self-serve activation, onboarding, upgrade flows) - desirable, not required

 - A plus: experience applying LLMs or agents (research, enrichment, next-best-action, automated diagnosis)



Compensation and benefits

 - The estimated base salary range for this role is $230K-$250K, depending on experience and location. The offer also includes a a generous pre-IPO equity package.

You’ll own end-to-end financial disclosure for a portfolio of high growth clients in mining at a pivotal stage: moving from exploration and evaluation into mine construction, commissioning and commercial production.  Own the story behind the numbers: Draft and polish quarterly and annual financial statements and MD&A, including non-GAAP measures such as cash costs and all-in sustaining costs, that stand up to capital-markets scrutiny and tell each client’s path from discovery to production.

Assess technical feasibility and commercial viability, reclassify E&E assets to mine development with the required impairment test, determine when an asset is ready for its intended use, and track capex and burn rate against construction milestones.

 Guard continuous disclosure: Stay ahead of regulatory changes, draft timely filings, and ensure nothing slips through the cracks on SEDAR+ or EDGAR.

 Maintient une solide connaissance des réglementations et normes mondiales applicables aux jouets et aux produits de consommation, ainsi que des meilleures pratiques de l’industrie, et veille à ce que ces exigences soient bien comprises et appliquées par l’équipe.
 Se tient au fait des nouvelles exigences réglementaires, normes, technologies et pratiques de l’industrie, ainsi que de leur évolution, et soutient la mise en œuvre des changements applicables au sein de l’organisation.
 Identifie les risques systémiques liés aux produits et aux processus dans les secteurs sous sa responsabilité et élabore, avec les partenaires interfonctionnels appropriés, des stratégies visant à atténuer ces risques.
 Met à profit son expertise en ingénierie de la qualité et les leçons apprises afin de contribuer au développement et à l’amélioration des pratiques et processus de l’organisation.
 Leadership et développement de l’équipe 
 Dirige, accompagne et développe une équipe d’ingénieurs qualité, en renforçant leurs compétences en matière de systèmes qualité, d’exigences réglementaires, de résolution de problèmes techniques, de gestion des risques, d’analyse de données et de prise de décision.
 Établit des objectifs, priorités, attentes et responsabilités clairs pour l’équipe et veille à leur alignement avec les objectifs de l’ingénierie de la qualité et de l’entreprise.
 Offre un accompagnement et une rétroaction continus, assure la gestion de la performance et soutient le développement de carrière des membres de l’équipe.
 Développe les compétences techniques et de leadership de l’équipe grâce au mentorat, à des mandats stimulants, au partage des connaissances et à la planification du développement.
 Évalue les capacités de l’équipe et les besoins en ressources et répartit les ressources d’ingénierie de façon appropriée en fonction de la complexité et des risques des produits, de la charge de travail et des priorités d’affaires.
 Soutient le recrutement, l’intégration, le développement, la planification de la relève et la rétention des talents en ingénierie de la qualité.
 Crée un environnement favorisant la curiosité technique, la collaboration, la responsabilisation, l’apprentissage continu et l’escalade appropriée des préoccupations liées à la qualité et à la sécurité des produits.
 Influence interfonctionnelle 
 Établit de solides partenariats avec les équipes de Marketing, Design, Développement de produits, Sécurité des produits, Conformité réglementaire, Analytique des données qualité, Play Labs, Fabrication, laboratoires et autres fonctions partenaires.
 Veille à ce que l’ingénierie de la qualité soit impliquée de façon appropriée tout au long du développement des produits afin d’influencer les décisions ayant une incidence sur la qualité, la sécurité, la conformité, la fiabilité et la satisfaction des consommateurs.
 Anticipe les impacts en aval, les occasions et les risques, et veille à une collaboration et une communication interfonctionnelles appropriées afin d’assurer une résolution efficace.
 Influence les équipes et les leaders interfonctionnels afin qu’ils prennent des décisions équilibrées et fondées sur les risques, tout en maintenant la sécurité des consommateurs et la conformité réglementaire comme exigences fondamentales.
 Assure le leadership de l’ingénierie de la qualité lors d’enjeux importants liés à la qualité, à la sécurité, à la conformité, à la fabrication ou à la performance des produits après leur mise en marché.
 Établit des pratiques efficaces de communication et d’escalade au sein de l’équipe afin que les risques importants soient communiqués de façon appropriée à la direction de l’ingénierie de la qualité et aux parties prenantes interfonctionnelles.
 Prise de décision et stratégie de données 
 Favorise une prise de décision objective et fondée sur les données au sein de l’équipe d’ingénierie de la qualité.
 Veille à ce que les ingénieurs identifient, recueillent, analysent et interprètent adéquatement les données nécessaires pour soutenir les décisions liées à la qualité et aux risques des produits.
 Examine les analyses techniques et les recommandations relatives aux enjeux complexes ou présentant un risque plus élevé et s’assure que les conclusions sont techniquement solides, clairement communiquées et adéquatement documentées.
 Utilise les données provenant des essais de produits, des plaintes des consommateurs, des retours, de l’analytique des données qualité, des résultats des Play Labs, de la performance de fabrication et d’autres sources disponibles afin d’identifier les tendances, les risques émergents et les possibilités d’amélioration.
 Établit et suit les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et les mesures de qualité appropriés pour les secteurs sous sa responsabilité, et veille à ce que les tendances et enjeux significatifs donnent lieu aux actions nécessaires.
 Communique les tendances importantes en matière de qualité, les risques et les recommandations à la direction de l’ingénierie de la qualité et aux parties prenantes interfonctionnelles.
 Excellence technique et en ingénierie 
 Assure le leadership technique et la supervision des investigations de produits, des analyses de causes fondamentales, des études d’ingénierie, des stratégies d’échantillonnage, des évaluations des risques ainsi que des activités de vérification et de validation des produits.
 Veille à l’utilisation appropriée de méthodologies d’investigation et de résolution de problèmes telles que les diagrammes d’Ishikawa (Fishbone), les 5 pourquoi, l’AMDEC (FMEA) et d’autres outils applicables d’analyse des causes fondamentales.
 Supervise et guide l’élaboration et le maintien des documents d’exigences produit (PRD), des documents de préoccupations principales (PCD), des stratégies d’essai et des autres documents d’ingénierie de la qualité.
 Veille à ce que les concepts de produits, les modes de jeu prévus, les utilisations et mauvaises utilisations raisonnablement prévisibles, les interactions avec les consommateurs et les risques identifiés soient adéquatement traduits en stratégies robustes d’essai et de vérification.
 Collabore avec les laboratoires internes et les organismes d’essais tiers afin de s’assurer que les stratégies d’essai répondent adéquatement aux exigences réglementaires, aux risques identifiés et aux attentes en matière de performance des produits.
 S’assure que les investigations et les actions correctives sont complètes, techniquement solides, adéquatement documentées et réalisées dans les délais requis.
 Fournit des orientations techniques concernant l’application et l’interprétation appropriées des analyses statistiques, des plans d’échantillonnage, des études d’ingénierie et des données qualité.
 Veille à l’exécution appropriée des activités de gestion des risques et à l’utilisation d’outils tels que l’AMDEC (FMEA), l’analyse par arbre de défaillances (FTA), l’analyse préliminaire des risques (PHA) et d’autres méthodologies pertinentes.
 Maintient une connaissance approfondie des procédures internes du système de gestion de la qualité (QMS) et veille à ce que l’équipe respecte les processus et exigences applicables.
 Qualité des produits et expérience consommateur 
 Veille à ce que la connaissance des produits, l’utilisation prévisible par les consommateurs et les modes de jeu soient pris en compte dans les décisions d’ingénierie de la qualité et les évaluations des risques liés aux produits.
 Utilise les données des systèmes qualité, les commentaires des consommateurs, les résultats d’essais, les retours de produits, la performance de fabrication et les informations post-commercialisation afin de comprendre la performance des produits et des processus.
 Identifie les possibilités d’améliorer la qualité, la fiabilité, la durabilité des produits et la satisfaction des consommateurs à partir des données disponibles et des leçons apprises.
 Dirige ou soutient l’investigation et la résolution d’enjeux importants liés à la qualité et à la sécurité des produits après leur mise en marché dans les secteurs sous sa responsabilité.
 Collabore avec les équipes interfonctionnelles afin que les leçons tirées des commentaires des consommateurs et de la performance sur le terrain soient intégrées au développement des produits actuels et futurs.
 Culture et amélioration continue 
 Favorise une culture axée sur la qualité, la sécurité des consommateurs, la responsabilisation, l’apprentissage continu et la responsabilité partagée au sein de l’équipe et dans les partenariats interfonctionnels.
 Identifie et dirige des initiatives d’amélioration continue dans les secteurs sous sa responsabilité en appliquant les méthodologies et outils d’amélioration continue appropriés.
 Évalue les processus d’ingénierie de la qualité et identifie les possibilités d’en améliorer l’efficacité, la cohérence, l’évolutivité et l’efficience.
 Dirige des initiatives d’amélioration interfonctionnelles et veille à ce que les améliorations demeurent conformes aux exigences réglementaires, aux normes et aux exigences internes du système de gestion de la qualité.
 Utilise les KPI, les indicateurs de qualité, les leçons apprises et l’analyse comparative afin d’identifier les possibilités d’amélioration.
 Favorise l’adoption et le partage des meilleures pratiques entre les équipes d’ingénierie de la qualité.
 Élabore, lorsque pertinent, des analyses de rentabilité pour les possibilités d’amélioration importantes et communique les impacts attendus sur la qualité, les opérations, les consommateurs et l’entreprise.

 Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et solides aptitudes en leadership, avec une capacité démontrée à diriger, accompagner, développer et mobiliser des professionnels techniques.
 Connaissance démontrée des normes réglementaires applicables aux produits de consommation, particulièrement aux jouets ou aux produits destinés aux enfants.
 Solide jugement technique et capacité à évaluer des enjeux complexes liés à la qualité et à la sécurité des produits, à la réglementation, à la fabrication et aux consommateurs, et à prendre des décisions éclairées fondées sur les risques.
